parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs with their indications. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication. Filter for max_phase_for_ind = 4. Return chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
